acs.criterion: `eh run` computes cost from its own cumulative normalized usage x the resolved model's gateway rates — honoring `--gateway-provider` pins (per-endpoint pricing, not model-aggregate) and tiered prompt/completion rates — and emits it on the final `cumulative: true` `usage` event and/or `run.completed` as `costUsd` with `costSource: "gateway-rates"`.
A harness-reported cost, when present, is preserved in a separate field (e.g. `harnessCostUsd`), never silently preferred over the computed one.
When rates are unavailable (ollama, unknown model), no fabricated cost is emitted and `costSource` says why.

Cache read/write tokens are billed at the endpoint's published cache rates; when an endpoint publishes no cache rates, the chosen behavior (bill as regular input vs zero) is explicit and documented in the code.
If the event shape changes, the NDJSON event `v` field is bumped per eh's versioned-stream convention.
